text: ふむ　ゼニガメが　いいか！

structure.jp: ゼニガメが　いいか！
structure.en: so Squirtle is the one you want!

patterns.name: 〜がいい
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by がいい says that this is the one you pick or want. ゼニガメがいい = 'Squirtle is the one I want'.

patterns.name: 〜か (realization)
patterns.explanation: か said with a falling voice is not a question here; the speaker is taking in what he just learned. いいか = 'so that's the one you want'.
